about.title: About
about.desc: Nontonin is a cinema ticketing app with a 3D seat preview. Before you buy, you can see what the screen looks like from the seat you pick.
about.credit: The 3D seat preview in this app is inspired by the "{{concept}}" UI/UX concept by {{designer}}.
about.disclaimer: Every cinema, film and poster in this app is fictional and made for the demo.
about.disclaimerTmdb: The cinemas, showtimes and payments in this app are fictional and made for the demo.
about.tmdb: Film data and images are provided by TMDB. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
about.builtWith: Built with Next.js, Mantine and Three.js
